articles.headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: USA-France gold medal game preview
articles.description: It's the World Cup finale fans wanted to see: Team USA and France will meet in a rematch of the Olympic gold medal game.

images.name: Breanna Stewart [1296x729]
images.caption: Breanna Stewart and the U.S. women beat Spain to return to the gold medal game. Stewart led Team USA with 16 points, which included 8 of 11 free throws.

images.name: Gabby Williams [1296x729]
images.caption: Gabby Williams and France are 5-0 in Berlin. Williams led Les Bleues with 22 points on 8-of-12 shooting Saturday.

images.name: Aliyah Boston [1296x1296]
images.caption: Aliyah Boston scored six points and grabbed a team-high seven rebounds off the bench for the U.S. women on Saturday.

articles.headline: U.S. tops Spain, gears up for FIBA final vs. France in '24 Olympic rematch
articles.description: The U.S. pulled away in a 76-66 win over Spain while France routed Germany on Saturday, setting up a highly anticipated clash in Sunday's FIBA World Cup final.

images.name: Breanna Stewart [600x400]
images.caption: Breanna Stewart scored a team-high 16 points in Saturday's semifinal win over Spain. The U.S. will chase its fifth consecutive World Cup gold medal on Sunday against France.

articles.headline: France tops host Germany to reach FIBA World Cup final
articles.description: Gabby Williams had 22 points and five rebounds to lead France to the final of the women's FIBA World Cup with a win over host Germany.

articles.headline: Team USA hears coach's message entering FIBA World Cup semis
articles.description: As Team USA gears up for the FIBA World Cup semifinals, it feels it is poised to play its best basketball because of how coach Kara Lawson has challenged its players.

images.name: 260911 Lawson [1296x729]
images.caption: Team USA coach Kara Lawson has challenged her players "to compete at a high level" following its close call vs. Italy on Sunday. Said Napheesa Collier: "I don't think we're going to have that problem again."
